blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings was 2 in June and 1 in September, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall, and it took 5.4% of the city’s 37 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings rose from 7 in June to 9 in September (+28.6%), and it took 7.1% of the city’s 56 sales over the period.

items.t: The closest official planning name for its southern edge is the North Lougheed Area (approximately 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road).

Where condo stock concentrates: it does not concentrate — there is one complex. The Fairways sits on Meadow Gardens Way at the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course on the sub-area's south edge; the rest of the sub-area is RS/RR houses and A-1/A-2 farm properties in the Pitt Polder.

Community (Pitt Meadows; medians are published at community level only) — detached median $1,160,000, $550/sq ft, 95% sale-to-list, 41 days on market; condos & townhomes median $662,500, $566/sq ft, 97% sale-to-list, 40 days on market. Pitt Meadows sits with the GVR board for these stats — the SnapStats FVR report contains no Pitt Meadows section. SnapStats GVR September 2026 report.

Transit: the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus stops at Harris Road on the south edge; route 701 runs via Harris Road and Hammond Road along the south edge to Pitt Meadows Station; route 719 serves Wildwood Crescent and Hammond Road. There is no West Coast Express station in this sub-area (Pitt Meadows Station is south of Lougheed Highway), and no bus route serving the rural north itself was confirmed.

Schools and catchments: SD42 catchments are address-based, and SD42 has no middle tier in Pitt Meadows (elementary K–7, then secondary). Highland Park Elementary, 18961 Advent Road, is physically in the sub-area; Pitt Meadows Secondary, 19438 116B Avenue, sits south of the sub-area. For the sample address 18961 Advent Road, the SD42 School Locator returns Highland Park Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary. Any other address is UNVERIFIED until run.

Parks: Harris Road Park, 12474 Harris Road (concession, spray park, skate park, playground, walking trail, ball diamonds, outdoor pool, basketball court); Grabenhorst Garden, 13895 Harris Road; the Codd Island Wetlands, undiked floodplain wetlands on the Alouette River in the rural north, are on the City heritage register.

Health: the nearest hospital is Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, Maple Ridge (24/7 emergency); the Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 121-11900 Haney Place, Maple Ridge, open 9:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., 7 days a week. Pitt Meadows has no hospital.

Flood/ALR setting: over 95% of Pitt Meadows is in the floodplain per the City's 2020 Business Plan, protected by roughly 60 km of dikes, and this sub-area is the low Pitt Polder land drained by floodboxes and pump stations (Alouette Pump Station, Fenton and Pitt Polder catchments). Most of the city's land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve.

items.t: The board line on Advent Road cuts across the street. Anyone searching "55+ Pitt Meadows" by street will land on Advent Road; anyone searching by board sub-area will not find it under North Meadows.

Two near-identical names, two tenures, one street. Meadowland Village (18960 Advent Rd) is the buyable 55+ strata; Meadowlands Housing Co-operative (19032 Advent Rd) is a 55+ co-op where members hold shares and nothing is ever listed as a strata sale. Both are board-classed with Central Meadows and covered there.

The city's floodplain figure has two live versions. The City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of Pitt Meadows is in the floodplain; live guide pages quote "over 85%" sourced to the City Financial Plan 2026–2030.

The golf-course condos are the sub-area's only strata — and the count is not settled. The Fairways' developer figure is 268 homes, counts conflict across sources, and its registered age position is UNCONFIRMED — three separate facts a listing sheet will present as settled. The strata plan (BCS2427) and Form B are the documents that settle all three.

The rural north has no bus. Confirmed transit is all on the Lougheed/Harris south edge (R3, 701, 719); the Pitt Polder farm roads have no confirmed route at all, which matters for any buyer planning to age in place without driving.

The North Lougheed Area Plan is adopted but not built. OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026 covers roughly 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway, and the City states development will proceed gradually with further planning, studies and Council approvals — no residential presale in the sub-area was verified.

Well and septic are per-lot questions. Whether a given North Meadows lot is on municipal water/sewer or on a well and septic system is not confirmed per lot on an official source — check the provincial GWELLS well records and Fraser Health's onsite-sewerage rules (only an Authorized Person can design, install, repair, maintain or inspect a system) before subject removal on a rural lot.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in North Meadows
The Fairways — 19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way

A resort-style condominium complex on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, developed by Magusta Development, whose own portfolio page describes "an exclusive collection of 268 resort-style homes" built around a courtyard, with a Residents' Club overlooking the golf course offering exercise facilities, a massage space, a lounge and kitchen, and a games room. MLS listing records for units at both addresses record sub-type Apartment/Condo, subdivision name The Fairways, year built 2007, title to land Freehold Strata, and amenities including clubhouse, exercise centre, sauna/steam room, bike room, guest suite, caretaker and in-suite laundry; one listing records a new roof in 2022. Pet position is listing-level only: listings describe the complex as pet friendly, record "Cats OK", and one ground-floor listing states "one dog or up to two cats welcome" — a verified building bylaw summary is UNCONFIRMED. Rental position: no building-level rental restriction is published in the sources checked — and any long-term rental bylaw would in any case be void under the Nov 24, 2022 rule in. Age restriction: no source checked publishes a 55+ bylaw for The Fairways, and listings market the complex to families and professionals and list a kids playroom among the amenities — do NOT treat The Fairways as a 55+ complex; a registered-bylaw age position is UNCONFIRMED until the Form B is read.
Streets, schools and getting around North Meadows

items.t: "North Meadows" — styled "North Meadows PI" in the guide feed labels — is an MLS® sub-area name for the part of Pitt Meadows north of Lougheed Highway (Highway 7), covering the Highland Park and Wildwood residential areas, Harris Road north, and the rural Pitt Polder lands beyond; the City does not publish a boundary for it, and the closest official description is the North Lougheed Area, about 50 ha on the north side of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road. No official boundary: UNVERIFIED.

Where the condo stock concentrates: one pocket only — Meadow Gardens Way, on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course, where The Fairways stands. The rest of the sub-area's feed runs to large farm acreages on Richardson Road and Hale Road and boat-access-only cabins on Debeck Creek at Pitt Lake; whether the board draws the sub-area as wide as Pitt Lake on purpose is UNVERIFIED.

SnapStats publishes medians at community level only: the Pitt Meadows condos & townhomes median was $662,500 in September 2026 ($566/sqft, 97% sale-to-list, 40 days on market), as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report.
There is no West Coast Express station in this sub-area, and no bus route serving the rural north itself was confirmed: UNVERIFIED.

SD42 has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12) and catchments are address-based; the recorded locator run for 18961 Advent Road returned Highland Park Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary, plus French Immersion options. Catchments for other addresses: UNVERIFIED.

Parks and anchors: Harris Road Park, 12474 Harris Road / 12474 Lougheed Highway (spray park, skate park, outdoor pool, diamonds); Grabenhorst Garden, 13895 Harris Road; Codd Island Wetlands on the Alouette River, on the City heritage register; heritage sites include the Japanese Canadian Hall, 19089 Advent Road, and the Pitt Meadows School House, 13414 Harris Road. No library branch is in this sub-area — the city branch is Pitt Meadows Public Library, 200-12099 Harris Road.

items.t: Short-term rentals are PROHIBITED in Pitt Meadows: — a city layer, separate from the void strata bylaws: a City staff report states "Short-term rental accommodation is not a permitted use in Zoning Bylaw" — the use itself is banned city-wide, including for the Pitt Lake cabins in the guide feed. Pitt Meadows also appears in the Province's principal-residence-requirement community list.

Floodplain and ALR: the City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of the Pitt Meadows land base lies within the floodplain for the Fraser River and, to a smaller degree, the Pitt River — the guide page's "over 85%" Financial Plan figure is superseded and retired here. The city is almost entirely protected by 60 km of dikes; the northern drainage areas (Alouette Pump Station catchment, Fenton, and the Pitt Polder catchment) are drained by floodboxes and pump stations, and the Codd Island Wetlands are undiked floodplain wetlands. The same Business Plan states 78% of the city's land falls within the Agricultural Land Reserve; on ALR land the Agricultural Land Commission allows one additional detached residence without an application where one residence already exists when construction begins, to a maximum of 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less.

items.t: The guide page's footer email is wrong — Jerry sweep item. The live guide page footer carries "jared@jaredgibbons.ca"; the correct address is jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca, which the page itself uses in its contact sections.

This sub-area's feed runs from a golf course to a lake. Two of the guide feed's first twelve listings are boat-access-only cabins on Debeck Creek at Pitt Lake, labelled "North Meadows PI" — the same sub-area label as The Fairways condos at the city's urban edge. Whether the board draws the sub-area that wide on purpose is UNVERIFIED, and the cabins are not condo stock.

The Advent Road school and the Advent Road 55+ pocket are in different sub-areas on paper. Highland Park Elementary stands at 18961 Advent Rd inside North Meadows, while the Meadowland Village / Meadowlands co-op pocket further along Advent Road is board-classified Central Meadows. Street name alone does not settle sub-area — the board label on the listing does.

The floodplain figure has a stale twin on the guide page. The City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of the land base is in the floodplain; the guide page's Planning section quotes a Financial Plan 2026–2030 figure of "over 85%". The 95% figure governs.

The Codd Island Wetlands are undiked. Unlike the diked urban and farm land around them, the Codd Island Wetlands on the Alouette River are undiked floodplain wetlands on the City heritage register — flood protection in the rural north is pump-and-floodbox drainage, not a uniform dike ring.

Rural servicing is a per-lot question. Whether a given North Meadows lot is on municipal water/sewer or on a well and septic system is not confirmed per lot on an official source: UNVERIFIED. Well records can be checked in the provincial GWELLS application, and an onsite sewerage system must comply with the Sewerage System Regulation.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in North Meadows PI

items.t: Form B diligence (the area's one strata, The Fairways — condos program): SPA s.59 — fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; rules, budget, Rental Disclosure Statement, most recent depreciation report attached; within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page. At The Fairways the Form B/strata plan (BCS2427) is also where the conflicting unit count and the UNCONFIRMED age position are settled.

Rental-restriction bylaws VOID: since Nov 24, 2022 — any directory "rentals not allowed" line for a Pitt Meadows strata is VOID for long-term rentals. Separate city layer: short-term rentals are PROHIBITED in Pitt Meadows — a city rule the strata-law voiding does not cure.
Fee-simple reality (this sub-area's dominant form): a fee-simple home/townhome carries NO strata, NO Form B, NO strata fees — municipal rules (Zoning Bylaw No.

City zoning/OCP: Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 — A-1 General Agricultural min lot 8 ha (one farm house to 500 m² GFA); A-2 min 16 ha; RR-2 4 ha, RR-3 2 ha, RR-4 1 ha (RR = land outside the ALR); RS Large Lot Residential min 0.2 ha. One garden suite per lot (33–90 m²) in A-1/A-2/RR-1–RR-5/RS zones (garden suite OR secondary suite, not both); on ALR land the ALC allows one additional detached residence to 90 m² on ≤40 ha where conditions are met, without an application. Buildings in A-1/A-2 sited 15 m from watercourses/key ditches. OCP: "I See Pitt Meadows 2040"; North Lougheed Area Plan adopted by OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026 (~50 ha, gradual development, further approvals required).

Floodplain — LIVE CONFLICT, retired to 95%: the City's 2020 Business Plan states over 95% of Pitt Meadows is in the floodplain; live pages quoting "over 85%" (City Financial Plan 2026–2030 attribution) conflict with it.

Taxes/rebates/financing: PTT 1% / 2% / 3% plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3M — any "Over $3M — 5%" line compresses 3% + 2%, flagged. Exemptions: first-time buyers full on first $500,000 at ≤$835,000, partial to $860,000; newly built full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000. Example (input: $662,500 community attached median, no exemption): $2,000 + $9,250 = $11,250. FTHB GST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 — never March 12): 100% to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, max $50,000, agreements Mar 20, 2025–2031; New Housing Rebate 36%, max $6,300, $350K–$450K phase-out; HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 / $8,000; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%. GST on new construction, not resales (The Fairways is 2007 resale stock). Vancouver EHT does NOT apply.

The guide page is headed "North Meadows, Pitt Meadows: Guide | Jared Gibbons" (byline dated October 18, 2026), with the live feed inline under a count header "1-12 / 22" (snapshot only) — every card read is labelled "North Meadows PI", Pitt Meadows, Status: Active, on Meadow Gardens Way, Richardson Road, Hale Road and Debeck Creek.

Boundaries: no official boundary for the sub-area was found: UNVERIFIED as an official boundary. The guide's working description — the part of the city north of Lougheed Highway, including the rural land beyond the urban area — is the page's own description, not an official boundary. Nearby areas: Central Meadows, Mid Meadows, South Meadows and West Meadows (same city), Maple Ridge across the Pitt River to the east, and Port Coquitlam to the west.
Pitt Meadows community — Detached median $1,160,000; attached median $662,500, expressly NOT North Meadows figures. No North Meadows median is published: UNVERIFIED.
How people search for it: "North Meadows"; "North Meadows PI"; "Highland Park"; "Wildwood"; "Pitt Polder".

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in North Meadows

items.t: OCP — "I See Pitt Meadows 2040," Official Community Plan Bylaw No. 2864, 2020: covering the whole city including this sub-area, plus the North Lougheed Area Plan, adopted by OCP Amendment Bylaw No. 3060, 2026, covering approximately 50 ha north of Lougheed Highway between Meadows Gardens Golf Course and Harris Road, with development to proceed gradually and further approvals required.

Zoning — Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011: A-1 General Agricultural minimum lot area for subdivision 8 ha (one farm house per lot to a maximum gross floor area of 500 sq m); A-2 Large Lot Agricultural minimum 16 ha; RR-2 minimum 4 ha; RR-3 minimum 2 ha; RR-4 minimum 1 ha (RR zones are for land outside the ALR); RS Large Lot Residential minimum 0.2 ha. A garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR-1 to RR-5 and RS zones, one per lot, 33 sq m to 90 sq m, and a property may have a garden suite or a secondary suite, not both. Any specific parcel's zone and ALR status: per-parcel, UNVERIFIED.

Subdivision and servicing — Pitt Meadows: subdivision follows the zone minimums above and, where ALR applies, ALC approval (ALR block below). The Pitt Meadows servicing bylaw number is UNCONFIRMED — no number is quoted and no other city's bylaw is borrowed; the documented process is zone minimums + dike/drainage position, confirmed with the City for the parcel. Per-lot well/septic versus municipal services: UNVERIFIED.

ALR block (78% of the city in the ALR; this sub-area's rural ground is the ALR heartland — parcel status per-address, UNVERIFIED here): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). Caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); the research also records the ALC path in its own terms — one additional detached residence without an application where there is one existing residence when construction begins, to a maximum of 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less.
Foreclosure, where met: the settled court process (Rules 21-7/13-5, PD-66, Form 60); Form B and PTT/GST treatment on court sales: UNCONFIRMED.

faq.q: What sold in North Meadows in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 1 active listing and 2 sold, which prints as a 200% sales ratio — that ratio exceeds 100% only on those tiny counts (1 active versus 2 sold) and is explicitly NOT a demand signal. Condos & Townhomes recorded 9 active listings and 2 sold (22%). At the Pitt Meadows community level — NOT North Meadows' figures — the detached median sale price was $1,160,000 and the Condos & Townhomes median was $662,500 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Can an acreage lot have a second dwelling, and can I short-term rent it?
faq.a: A garden suite is permitted in the A-1, A-2, RR and RS zones, one per lot at 33 to 90 sq m, and on ALR land the Agricultural Land Commission also allows one additional detached residence to 90 sq m on properties 40 ha or less where the conditions are met. Short-term rentals are a different answer: they are PROHIBITED in Pitt Meadows — short-term rental accommodation is not a permitted use in the Zoning Bylaw.

faq.q: Is North Meadows in a floodplain or the Agricultural Land Reserve?
faq.a: Largely, yes to both on the City's current figures: over 95% of Pitt Meadows lies within the Fraser River and Pitt River floodplain behind 60 km of dikes, 78% of the city's land is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, and the northern Pitt Polder catchments drain to the Pitt River by floodboxes and pump stations — the guide page's "over 85%" Financial Plan figure is superseded and is recorded as a live-page error in Section 1.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in North Meadows Pitt Meadows than in June?
faq.a: In North Meadows Pitt Meadows, listings of houses was 2 in June and 1 in September, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall; condos and townhomes rose from 7 in June to 9 in September (+28.6%).

faq.q: How big is North Meadows Pitt Meadows compared with the rest of Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: In September 2026, North Meadows Pitt Meadows held 2.7% of the 37 houses listed in Pitt Meadows and 13.6% of the 66 condos and townhomes listed in Pitt Meadows.

faq.q: How many homes sold in North Meadows Pitt Meadows from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 houses and 4 condos and townhomes sold in North Meadows Pitt Meadows over those 4 months.

faq.q: How many condo buildings does North Meadows have?
faq.a: Everything else in the sub-area is freehold houses and farm properties.

faq.q: Is The Fairways a 55+ building? It sits on a golf course and gets marketed to downsizers.
faq.a: No source checked states any age restriction, and listings describe it as suiting "downsizers, families & professionals alike," pet-friendly, with a kids room among the amenities — "resort-style" in the marketing does not mean age-restricted. Settle the bylaw question from the strata's registered bylaws and Form B.

faq.q: How many homes are in The Fairways?
faq.a: Verify against the strata plan (BCS2427) before relying on any count.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Fairways unit?
faq.a: Long-term, yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. Short-term rentals are different: Pitt Meadows prohibits STRs at the city level, a separate layer that the strata-law change does not remove.

faq.q: How did North Meadows sell in September 2026?
Is there really a condo complex in North Meadows?
faq.a: Yes — one. The Fairways (19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way), a 268-home resort-style condominium complex by Magusta Development on the edge of Meadow Gardens Golf Course; unit listings record Apartment/Condo sub-type, built 2007, freehold strata.

No source checked publishes a 55+ bylaw for it, and its listings market to families and professionals and list a kids playroom, gym and guest suites among the amenities — do not treat it as 55+. The registered-bylaw position is UNCONFIRMED until the Form B is read. The area's genuine 55+ stock is the Advent Road pocket, which the board files as Central Meadows.

faq.q: Are pets allowed at The Fairways?
faq.a: Listing-level evidence says yes: listings call it pet friendly, record "Cats OK", and one states "one dog or up to two cats welcome". Pet bylaws remain enforceable in BC, so the registered bylaws in the Form B package govern for a specific purchase.
